"}</script>
<script>(() => {
  'use strict';
  const form = document.getElementById('login-form');
  const input = document.getElementById('password');
  const button = document.getElementById('enter');
  const message = document.getElementById('login-message');
  // Capture the encrypted edition before anyone types: exported HTML never contains a password.
  const protectedSource = '<!doctype html>\n' + document.documentElement.outerHTML;
  let busy = false;
  const decode = value => Uint8Array.from(atob(value), c => c.charCodeAt(0));
  form.addEventListener('submit', async event => {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (busy) return;
    if (!window.crypto?.subtle) {
      message.textContent = 'Apri il collegamento HTTPS in Safari o in un browser aggiornato.';
      return;
    }
    if (!input.value) { message.textContent = 'Inserisci la password.'; return; }
    busy = true;
    button.disabled = true;
    button.textContent = 'Apertura…';
    input.removeAttribute('aria-invalid');
    message.textContent = '';
    let passwordBytes;
    let decryptedBytes;
    try {
      const data = JSON.parse(document.getElementById('encrypted-project').textContent);
      if (data.version !== 1 || data.kdf !== 'PBKDF2-SHA256' || data.iterations !== 600000 || data.cipher !== 'AES-256-GCM') throw new Error('Invalid encrypted format');
      passwordBytes = new TextEncoder().encode(input.value);
      const base = await crypto.subtle.importKey('raw', passwordBytes, 'PBKDF2', false, ['deriveKey']);
      const key = await crypto.subtle.deriveKey({name:'PBKDF2', salt:decode(data.salt), iterations:data.iterations, hash:'SHA-256'}, base, {name:'AES-GCM', length:256}, false, ['decrypt']);
      decryptedBytes = new Uint8Array(await crypto.subtle.decrypt({name:'AES-GCM', iv:decode(data.iv), additionalData:new TextEncoder().encode('CasaMarco:1:PBKDF2-SHA256:600000:AES-256-GCM'), tagLength:128}, key, decode(data.content)));
      const html = new TextDecoder('utf-8', {fatal:true}).decode(decryptedBytes);
      if (!html.startsWith('<!doctype html>') || !html.includes('id="project-data"')) throw new Error('Invalid presentation');
      input.value = '';
      input.removeAttribute('value');
      window.__CASA_ENCRYPTED_SOURCE__ = protectedSource;
      document.open();
      document.write(html);
      document.close();
    } catch {
      input.value = '';
      input.setAttribute('aria-invalid', 'true');
      message.textContent = 'password errata';
      input.focus();
    } finally {
      passwordBytes?.fill(0);
      decryptedBytes?.fill(0);
      busy = false;
      button.disabled = false;
      button.textContent = 'Entra';
    }
  });
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
